description:
ChatStore::list_ids_paged takes (limit: u32, offset: u32) but ContactStore::list_ids_paged takes (offset: u32, limit: u32). The parameter order is reversed between the two sibling stores. A caller passing (limit, offset) to the ContactStore variant will silently apply them backwards, returning wrong pages without any compiler error.

File: crates/kith-store/src/chat.rs line 449: pub fn list_ids_paged(&self, limit: u32, offset: u32)
File: crates/kith-store/src/contact.rs line 207: pub fn list_ids_paged(&self, offset: u32, limit: u32)

Fix: align both to (limit: u32, offset: u32) matching the SQL parameter order (?1=LIMIT, ?2=OFFSET) which is already used by both implementations internally.
title: list_ids_paged: swapped (limit,offset) vs (offset,limit) between ChatStore and ContactStore
